message: I had a little power outage the other day, and it got me thinking about how being prepared can turn a minor inconvenience into a small win. I found this great resource from the Red Cross that offers simple tips for handling blackouts, like keeping a flashlight handy and having a stash of snacks ready to go. It's amazing how a bit of planning can make those unexpected moments feel a lot less stressful! How do you stay prepared for an unexpected power outage?
